text: 01Fighting for Livable WagesWorking families deserve pay that keeps up with the cost of living. Stacie is fighting to raise wages and protect workers across Ohio.Know More
02Funding Public EducationEvery child deserves a quality education. Stacie is committed to fully funding Ohio’s public schools and supporting teachers.Know More
03Funding Mental Health & Social ServicesAccess to mental health care and social services should not depend on your zip code. Stacie will expand funding for community-based programs.Know More
04Creating Affordable HousingToo many Ohio families are priced out of their own neighborhoods. Stacie will push for affordable housing development across District 3.Know More
05Creating a Sustainable WorkforceBuilding a future-ready workforce through vocational training, apprenticeships, and partnerships with local employers.Know More
06Funding ChildcareNo parent should have to choose between their career and their child. Stacie is fighting to make quality childcare affordable and accessible.Know More
07Data Centers & Ohio’s GridStacie is calling for a statewide moratorium on new large-scale data centers until Ohio has a real plan for ratepayers, water, and local control.Know More
